recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future OO decision changes the Device property model.
issue_request: FHIR-32568 asked why Device.property.value was optional and resolved to make Device.property.value 1.. because a property should have a value, not only a type.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to PR #1471 commit ff30e9f. The PR merge commit 79d69778f6662914640649ae32b8d03086c9bbbb, via implementation commit 20d37b330c8e08e98477dc607b2dcdedb368a60f, changed source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml so Device.property.value[x] moved from min 0 to min 1. Later commit 23d0f3c36f2244f7636e70edcfbd21cf074c49db again adjusted Device and DeviceDefinition property.value cardinality after intervening source refactors.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml current build input. Current source and the R5/current published profile surfaces show Device.property.value[x] as 1..1; R4 had separate optional valueQuantity/valueCode elements. Zulip exact-key searches found no FHIR-32568 discussion, and Confluence refs found OO HCP/Main minutes consistent with the Jira vote/application trail.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml already has Device.property.value[x] with min 1 and max 1.
